description: C8 native extension of the supplied C7 finite-MOM integrator. Original source remains unchanged in the uploaded archive.
changes: Target order 8; graph loops 2..8 and Taylor jets through order 8-L.
Fixed storage enlarged to 16 edges,31 Sobol coordinates,7 scalar slots and14 channel slots.
C8 graph/task/result schema; C7 graph payloads accepted for common-loop numerical regression.
Graph and gamma header input validation; no changes to forest denominators, summation order, promotion thresholds, rates or net construction.
MP backend remains GMP350 by default; decimal300 available as an explicitly selected alternative.
limitations: Actual C8 graph coverage and rates must be validated independently of common-slot native regression.
Native binary128/GMP350 cancellation thresholds are inherited from C7; new C8 endpoint checks are required before precision production.
